_description: Declarative Triage Policy Engine – production vibe-to-domain routing rules. Conversational/supervisory vibes omit RAG fields. Retrieval vibes define target_domain, traversal, allowed_collections, and max_distance.

CASUAL.description: Colloquial greetings and pleasantries – 'how are things?', 'how are you?', 'what's up?', 'hello', 'good morning', 'hi'. Social lubrication that requires no lab context.

SUPERVISORY.description: Supervisory feedback loop – user corrections, tone adjustments, preference nudges, persona tuning requests.

WYWO.description: 'While You Were Out' Standup Briefing – briefing the user on lab activity, engineering events, and subconscious dream synthesis during user absence.

META.description: Lab-internal meta queries – infrastructure status, resident agent health, system component diagnostics (vllm, attendant, foyer, audio_pipeline).

OPERATIONAL.description: Operational SRE queries – diagnostics, BKMs, playbooks, point-of-failure analysis, maintenance procedures.

FORENSIC.description: Forensic log analysis – crash dumps, kernel panics, OOM traces, error post-mortems, syslog forensics.

TECHNICAL.description: Technical deep-dive – silicon telemetry, PCIe AER errors, RAPL power/thermal analysis, VRAM utilization, CUDA driver diagnostics.

HISTORICAL.description: 18-year career archive – timeline queries, era lookups, project retrospectives, historical engineering decisions.

ANALYTICAL.description: Comparative, trade-off, architectural analysis with high objectivity.
